units.source_en: He thought of how the strong-willed Ieyasu had actually laughed and called the excrement he had passed on horseback miso soup.
units.source_zh: 他想到意志坚强的家康居然笑称拉在马背上的大便为酱汤。

paragraphs.source_zh: 忠世表情严峻。“大人，请原谅。”他喃喃地说。他想到意志坚强的家康居然笑称拉在马背上的大便为酱汤。

paragraphs.source_en: At the cliff’s edge, the snow lay knee-deep. Tadayo halted and ordered the twenty-six arquebuses trained on Anayama’s rear. “There is no need to aim. Simply light the fuses and fire, then all shout together.”

units.source_en: At the cliff’s edge, the snow lay knee-deep.
units.source_zh: 悬崖边上积雪已齐膝高。

units.source_en: Tadayo halted and ordered the twenty-six arquebuses trained on Anayama’s rear.
units.source_zh: 忠世停止前进，命令二十六支火枪对准了穴山的后背。

units.source_en: “There is no need to aim. Simply light the fuses and fire, then all shout together.”
units.source_zh: “不需要瞄准，只要点火放炮，然后齐声呐喊即可。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 悬崖边上积雪已齐膝高。忠世停止前进，命令二十六支火枪对准了穴山的后背。“不需要瞄准，只要点火放炮，然后齐声呐喊即可。”

paragraphs.source_en: The fuses were lit. The smell of gunpowder grew ever stronger, and before long the twenty-six arquebuses erupted with a tremendous roar. Amplified by the blazing fires within Hamamatsu Castle, the gunfire resounded through heaven and earth.

units.source_en: The fuses were lit.
units.source_zh: 引火线点着了。

units.source_en: The smell of gunpowder grew ever stronger, and before long the twenty-six arquebuses erupted with a tremendous roar.
units.source_zh: 火药味越来越浓，未几就听见二十六支火枪发出巨响。

units.source_en: Amplified by the blazing fires within Hamamatsu Castle, the gunfire resounded through heaven and earth.
units.source_zh: 再加上滨松城内的薪火助势，枪声响彻天地。

paragraphs.source_zh: 引火线点着了。火药味越来越浓，未几就听见二十六支火枪发出巨响。再加上滨松城内的薪火助势，枪声响彻天地。

paragraphs.source_en: The cries from Anayama’s troops drove the cold from the warriors’ bodies. Caught by the unexpected attack, Anayama’s forces erupted into panic and confusion.

units.source_en: The cries from Anayama’s troops drove the cold from the warriors’ bodies.
units.source_zh: 穴山军的叫喊声驱散了武士们身上的寒气。

units.source_en: Caught by the unexpected attack, Anayama’s forces erupted into panic and confusion.
units.source_zh: 由于受到出乎意料的袭击，穴山的军队一时炸窝，陷入一片混乱。

paragraphs.source_zh: 穴山军的叫喊声驱散了武士们身上的寒气。由于受到出乎意料的袭击，穴山的军队一时炸窝，陷入一片混乱。

paragraphs.source_en: “One more volley...” Tadayo cried loudly, suppressing his excitement.

units.source_en: “One more volley...” Tadayo cried loudly, suppressing his excitement.
units.source_zh: “再来一阵……”忠世抑制住激动，大声叫喊。

paragraphs.source_zh: “再来一阵……”忠世抑制住激动，大声叫喊。

paragraphs.source_en: After the two volleys and the sound of war drums from inside the castle, the Takeda army concluded that it was being attacked from both within and without. Strangely, the disorder spread as though contagious, swiftly passing from Anayama’s ranks to Yamagata’s and then to Oyamada’s army, until the Takeda forces finally decided to withdraw. Ōkubo Tadayo, Ishikawa, and Amano did not pursue them closely; but there was no doubt that their actions had terrified the Takeda men.

units.source_en: After the two volleys and the sound of war drums from inside the castle, the Takeda army concluded that it was being attacked from both within and without.
units.source_zh: 由于两番枪击和城内的战鼓声，武田军判断受到了内外夹击。

units.source_en: Strangely, the disorder spread as though contagious, swiftly passing from Anayama’s ranks to Yamagata’s and then to Oyamada’s army, until the Takeda forces finally decided to withdraw.
units.source_zh: 不可思议的是，混乱仿佛具有传染性，很快从穴山的队伍传到山县的队伍，再传到小山田的军队，武田军终于决定撤退。

units.source_en: Ōkubo Tadayo, Ishikawa, and Amano did not pursue them closely;
units.source_zh: 大久保忠世、石川和天野都没有紧追；

units.source_en: but there was no doubt that their actions had terrified the Takeda men.
units.source_zh: 但毋庸置疑，他们的行动吓破了武田人的胆。

paragraphs.source_zh: 由于两番枪击和城内的战鼓声，武田军判断受到了内外夹击。不可思议的是，混乱仿佛具有传染性，很快从穴山的队伍传到山县的队伍，再传到小山田的军队，武田军终于决定撤退。大久保忠世、石川和天野都没有紧追；但毋庸置疑，他们的行动吓破了武田人的胆。

paragraphs.source_en: Only when Ieyasu heard in the great hall that the Takeda army had finally withdrawn did overwhelming exhaustion engulf his whole body. This had certainly not been a skillfully fought battle, but a crushing defeat beyond words. Yet he had survived that crushing defeat and had even succeeded in halting the enemy’s pursuit. Of course, this was by no means Ieyasu’s achievement alone. It seemed that some invisible power governed it all, and in his heart he gave thanks to that power.

units.source_en: Only when Ieyasu heard in the great hall that the Takeda army had finally withdrawn did overwhelming exhaustion engulf his whole body.
units.source_zh: 家康在大厅听到武田军终于撤退的消息时，才感到全身极度疲劳。

units.source_en: This had certainly not been a skillfully fought battle, but a crushing defeat beyond words.
units.source_zh: 这决不是一次巧妙的战斗，而是无法用言语表达的惨败。

units.source_en: Yet he had survived that crushing defeat and had even succeeded in halting the enemy’s pursuit.
units.source_zh: 但经历了惨败的自己，竟然活着，而且成功地阻止敌人的追击。

units.source_en: Of course, this was by no means Ieyasu’s achievement alone.
units.source_zh: 当然，这决非家康一人的功劳。

units.source_en: It seemed that some invisible power governed it all, and in his heart he gave thanks to that power.
units.source_zh: 似有一种看不见的力量在支配这一切，他在内心感谢那种力量。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康在大厅听到武田军终于撤退的消息时，才感到全身极度疲劳。这决不是一次巧妙的战斗，而是无法用言语表达的惨败。但经历了惨败的自己，竟然活着，而且成功地阻止敌人的追击。当然，这决非家康一人的功劳。似有一种看不见的力量在支配这一切，他在内心感谢那种力量。

paragraphs.source_en: Fully armed servants brought chestnuts and rice balls from the kitchen. But Ieyasu did not have the food distributed; instead, he let the returning warriors stare at the rice balls with hungry, thirsty eyes.

units.source_en: Fully armed servants brought chestnuts and rice balls from the kitchen.
units.source_zh: 全副武装的下人从厨房里端来了栗子和饭团。

units.source_en: But Ieyasu did not have the food distributed; instead, he let the returning warriors stare at the rice balls with hungry, thirsty eyes.
units.source_zh: 但家康并未让下人将饭食分发下去，而是让不断回来的武士们睁着饥渴的眼睛盯着饭团。

paragraphs.source_zh: 全副武装的下人从厨房里端来了栗子和饭团。但家康并未让下人将饭食分发下去，而是让不断回来的武士们睁着饥渴的眼睛盯着饭团。

paragraphs.source_en: Torii Mototada, always so strong, had lost his younger brother, and flames seemed to burn in his eyes; Honda Heihachirō Tadakatsu, who had lost many of his men, felt waves of pain throughout his body.

units.source_en: Torii Mototada, always so strong, had lost his younger brother, and flames seemed to burn in his eyes;
units.source_zh: 一向坚强的鸟居元忠失去了弟弟，眼睛里仿佛燃烧着火焰；

units.source_en: Honda Heihachirō Tadakatsu, who had lost many of his men, felt waves of pain throughout his body.
units.source_zh: 失去了众多部下的本多平八郎忠胜则感到全身阵阵酸痛。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一向坚强的鸟居元忠失去了弟弟，眼睛里仿佛燃烧着火焰；失去了众多部下的本多平八郎忠胜则感到全身阵阵酸痛。

paragraphs.source_en: Suzuki Kyūzaburō brought Ieyasu’s spear. “I found it along the way.”

units.source_en: Suzuki Kyūzaburō brought Ieyasu’s spear.
units.source_zh: 铃木久三郎拿来了家康的长枪。

units.source_en: “I found it along the way.”
units.source_zh: “途中捡到的。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 铃木久三郎拿来了家康的长枪。“途中捡到的。”

paragraphs.source_en: “You may have it.” Ieyasu replied casually, then turned to Amano Kageyasu. “Where is Tadatsugu?”

units.source_en: “You may have it.”
units.source_zh: “送给你了。”

units.source_en: Ieyasu replied casually, then turned to Amano Kageyasu. “Where is Tadatsugu?”
units.source_zh: 家康漫不经心地回答，然后转身对天野康景道，“忠次呢？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “送给你了。”家康漫不经心地回答，然后转身对天野康景道，“忠次呢？”

paragraphs.source_en: “He is still being treated by the kitchen.”

units.source_en: “He is still being treated by the kitchen.”
units.source_zh: “还在厨下接受治疗。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “还在厨下接受治疗。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Are his wounds serious?”

units.source_en: “Are his wounds serious?”
units.source_zh: “伤得重吗？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “伤得重吗？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Four arrows have been pulled out. They are washing the wounds with sake.”

units.source_en: “Four arrows have been pulled out.
units.source_zh: “拔出了四根箭。

units.source_en: They are washing the wounds with sake.”
units.source_zh: 正在用酒洗。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “拔出了四根箭。正在用酒洗。”

paragraphs.source_en: In truth, every one of them had been wounded in the battle.

units.source_en: In truth, every one of them had been wounded in the battle.
units.source_zh: 其实，所有人都在这次战斗中受了伤。

paragraphs.source_zh: 其实，所有人都在这次战斗中受了伤。

paragraphs.source_en: “The people gathered here look like the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons. What an ugly sight.” At Ieyasu’s words, smiles at last appeared on the men’s faces.

units.source_en: “The people gathered here look like the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons. What an ugly sight.”
units.source_zh: “这里聚集的人，仿佛百鬼夜行，真是丑陋。”

units.source_en: At Ieyasu’s words, smiles at last appeared on the men’s faces.
units.source_zh: 听家康如此说，众人脸上终于露出了笑容。

paragraphs.source_zh: “这里聚集的人，仿佛百鬼夜行，真是丑陋。”听家康如此说，众人脸上终于露出了笑容。

paragraphs.source_en: When Ōkubo Tadayo returned, the food was finally distributed, along with a bowl of piping-hot sake for each man. They drank in silence, and one after another, tears began to flow. To those who had passed back and forth between life and death, Ieyasu alone still towered like a mighty peak. Did he know no fear?

units.source_en: When Ōkubo Tadayo returned, the food was finally distributed, along with a bowl of piping-hot sake for each man.
units.source_zh: 大久保忠世回来后，食物终于分发下去，每人都有一碗烫热的酒。

units.source_en: They drank in silence, and one after another, tears began to flow.
units.source_zh: 众人默默地饮着，不禁纷纷流下眼泪。

units.source_en: To those who had passed back and forth between life and death, Ieyasu alone still towered like a mighty peak.
units.source_zh: 在往来于生死间的他们看来，只有家康还是那么高大，仿佛一座巨峰。

units.source_en: Did he know no fear?
units.source_zh: 他难道不知恐惧吗？

paragraphs.source_zh: 大久保忠世回来后，食物终于分发下去，每人都有一碗烫热的酒。众人默默地饮着，不禁纷纷流下眼泪。在往来于生死间的他们看来，只有家康还是那么高大，仿佛一座巨峰。他难道不知恐惧吗？

paragraphs.source_en: Without thinking, Torii Mototada raised his cup. “When one thinks carefully, we may say that we won this battle. We ought to celebrate.” Yet his voice sounded like the bark of a dog.

units.source_en: Without thinking, Torii Mototada raised his cup.
units.source_zh: 鸟居元忠不觉举起酒杯。

units.source_en: “When one thinks carefully, we may say that we won this battle.
units.source_zh: “仔细想来，这一仗，我们算是赢了。

units.source_en: We ought to celebrate.”
units.source_zh: 应该祝贺。”

units.source_en: Yet his voice sounded like the bark of a dog.
units.source_zh: 他的声音却如狗吠。

paragraphs.source_zh: 鸟居元忠不觉举起酒杯。“仔细想来，这一仗，我们算是赢了。应该祝贺。”他的声音却如狗吠。

paragraphs.source_en: The bonfires burned until dawn, and the soldiers gradually fell asleep around them.

units.source_en: The bonfires burned until dawn, and the soldiers gradually fell asleep around them.
units.source_zh: 篝火一直燃烧到天亮，士兵们围着火堆逐渐入睡。

paragraphs.source_zh: 篝火一直燃烧到天亮，士兵们围着火堆逐渐入睡。

paragraphs.source_en: Only after receiving definite word of the Takeda army’s movements did the men of Hamamatsu Castle begin gathering their own dead. Inside and outside Hamamatsu Castle, countless new burial mounds suddenly appeared, covered in pillars of frost.

units.source_en: Only after receiving definite word of the Takeda army’s movements did the men of Hamamatsu Castle begin gathering their own dead.
units.source_zh: 滨松城在得到了武田军的确切动向后，方开始收拾自己人的尸体。

units.source_en: Inside and outside Hamamatsu Castle, countless new burial mounds suddenly appeared, covered in pillars of frost.
units.source_zh: 滨松城内外顿时增加了大量的坟冢，其上落满霜柱。

paragraphs.source_zh: 滨松城在得到了武田军的确切动向后，方开始收拾自己人的尸体。滨松城内外顿时增加了大量的坟冢，其上落满霜柱。

paragraphs.source_en: The Takeda army lost about four hundred men, while casualties on the Tokugawa side, including the losses among Oda’s reinforcements, numbered 1,180.

units.source_en: The Takeda army lost about four hundred men, while casualties on the Tokugawa side, including the losses among Oda’s reinforcements, numbered 1,180.
units.source_zh: 武田军约损失四百人，而德川方面加上损失的织田援军，伤亡一千一百八十人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 武田军约损失四百人，而德川方面加上损失的织田援军，伤亡一千一百八十人。

paragraphs.source_en: The third year of Genki, laden with clouds of sorrow, finally passed, and the New Year of the first year of Tenshō, 1573, soon arrived.

units.source_en: The third year of Genki, laden with clouds of sorrow, finally passed, and the New Year of the first year of Tenshō, 1573, soon arrived.
units.source_zh: 愁云密布的元龟三年终于过去了，很快迎来了天正元年（一五七三）的正月。

paragraphs.source_zh: 愁云密布的元龟三年终于过去了，很快迎来了天正元年（一五七三）的正月。

paragraphs.source_en: That New Year, no one in Hamamatsu Castle visited friends or relatives to exchange seasonal greetings. At year’s end, Shingen reached the Osakabe district and welcomed the New Year there. He was preparing to attack Noda Castle.

units.source_en: That New Year, no one in Hamamatsu Castle visited friends or relatives to exchange seasonal greetings.
units.source_zh: 这个正月，滨松城内没有一个人走亲访友，问候新年。

units.source_en: At year’s end, Shingen reached the Osakabe district and welcomed the New Year there.
units.source_zh: 信玄于年底到达刑部地区，在那里迎来了正月。

units.source_en: He was preparing to attack Noda Castle.
units.source_zh: 他准备进攻野田城。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这个正月，滨松城内没有一个人走亲访友，问候新年。信玄于年底到达刑部地区，在那里迎来了正月。他准备进攻野田城。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu lit the incense candle on the table, laid down his brush, and stepped onto the veranda. The sun had risen, staining heaven and earth blood-red. The icy wind lashed his skin with painful force. More and more people were vanishing from this world, and Ieyasu’s face was exceptionally cold.

units.source_en: Ieyasu lit the incense candle on the table, laid down his brush, and stepped onto the veranda.
units.source_zh: 家康点燃桌上的香烛，放下笔，来到廊下。

units.source_en: The sun had risen, staining heaven and earth blood-red.
units.source_zh: 太阳已经升起，天地一片血红。

units.source_en: The icy wind lashed his skin with painful force.
units.source_zh: 冰冷的风吹打着肌肤，十分疼痛。

units.source_en: More and more people were vanishing from this world, and Ieyasu’s face was exceptionally cold.
units.source_zh: 从这个世上消失的人越来越多，家康的脸异常冰冷。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康点燃桌上的香烛，放下笔，来到廊下。太阳已经升起，天地一片血红。冰冷的风吹打着肌肤，十分疼痛。从这个世上消失的人越来越多，家康的脸异常冰冷。

paragraphs.source_en: O-Ai’s eyes widened. “What... What did you lose?”

units.source_en: O-Ai’s eyes widened. “What... What did you lose?”
units.source_zh: 阿爱睁大眼：“什么……什么输了？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 阿爱睁大眼：“什么……什么输了？”

paragraphs.source_en: “I mean last year’s decisive battle. It was a rare and valuable trial.”

units.source_en: “I mean last year’s decisive battle.
units.source_zh: “去年的决战之事。

units.source_en: It was a rare and valuable trial.”
units.source_zh: 真是一次难得的历练。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “去年的决战之事。真是一次难得的历练。”

paragraphs.source_en: “O-Ai does not believe that was a defeat.”

units.source_en: “O-Ai does not believe that was a defeat.”
units.source_zh: “阿爱不觉得那是失败。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “阿爱不觉得那是失败。”

paragraphs.source_en: Everyone nodded as one without prior agreement. Honda Sakuzaemon edged forward and said, “My congratulations, my lord.”

units.source_en: Everyone nodded as one without prior agreement.

ja.t: わせたようにうなずいた。

units.source_zh: 众人都不约而同地点点头。

units.source_en: Honda Sakuzaemon edged forward and said, “My congratulations, my lord.”
units.source_zh: 本多作左卫门向前挪了挪，道：“恭祝主公。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 众人都不约而同地点点头。本多作左卫门向前挪了挪，道：“恭祝主公。”

paragraphs.source_en: “And congratulations to you all.” Everyone joined in a resounding New Year’s greeting, their voices so powerful they almost lifted the sleeves of Ieyasu’s robe.

units.source_en: “And congratulations to you all.”
units.source_zh: “同贺。”

units.source_en: Everyone joined in a resounding New Year’s greeting, their voices so powerful they almost lifted the sleeves of Ieyasu’s robe.
units.source_zh: 众人也一起响亮地问候，声音响得几乎掀开家康的衣袖。

paragraphs.source_zh: “同贺。”众人也一起响亮地问候，声音响得几乎掀开家康的衣袖。

paragraphs.source_en: When the New Year’s ceremony ended, everyone returned to the bustle of their daily duties.

units.source_en: When the New Year’s ceremony ended, everyone returned to the bustle of their daily duties.
units.source_zh: 贺年仪式结束后，众人又恢复了平日的忙碌。

paragraphs.source_zh: 贺年仪式结束后，众人又恢复了平日的忙碌。
